decisions.reason: Turnaround management is core to the firm's integrated, data-driven airport strategy and has its own dedicated web page, signaling strong commitment.
Apron connectivity is an enabling module for the integrated platform, though it may later be merged into broader suite offerings.
Billing software is further from the firm's operational core and could be deprioritized, but it adds recurring software revenue from airport customers.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed docking and apron hardware base and supports the firm's maintenance service business.
Apron resource management fits closely with turnaround and planning software and strengthens the integrated suite.
A safety alert service for controllers matches the firm's tower and surface movement expertise, and safety products have long lifecycles.
